text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Excellent!
A victory earned by unleashing everything you had!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I know it was a run I can be proud of in front of anyone!
Mom, Dad, and—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
choice_data_list: Let's not let our guard down and stay focused for next time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's all thanks to having such capable support!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Because you always keep me on my toes, I never end up making clumsy mistakes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So please continue to keep me on track
with just the right amount of discipline!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Letting my guard down without realizing it is the scariest thing...
I need to stay sharp."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"If I ever let my guard down again, please point it out.
I'm counting on you!"
